company.name: Nanograb
company.shortDescription: Nanograb is a computational drug discovery company that uses AI to generate the best combination of binders to treat different diseases.
company.description: Nanograb is a computational drug discovery company that uses AI to design drug compounds. The platform generates combinations of binders for treating different diseases. It focuses on targeting drugs to specific areas of the body. The system uses computational models to predict how molecules will interact. The company provides tools for planning and testing drug candidates. It also offers guidance and support for applying its AI technology in drug development.

productsAndServices.description: Nanograb's product that enables drugs to be targeted to specific areas of the body using advanced targeting capabilities.
